title: Engenheiro De Processos
description:
Resumo da Posição

O Engenheiro de Processos II – Completions é responsável por planejar, otimizar e garantir a eficiência dos processos operacionais dentro da linha de produto de Completions. Atua como suporte técnico estratégico às operações, assegurando a qualidade do serviço, conformidade com normas internacionais (API/ISO) e promovendo a melhoria contínua, contribuindo diretamente para a excelência operacional e resultados do negócio.

Responsabilidades

  • Planejar, implementar e otimizar processos operacionais, garantindo qualidade na execução e cumprimento das metas organizacionais de forma eficiente e eficaz.
  • Avaliar, monitorar e melhorar continuamente a eficiência dos processos e procedimentos do Plano de Controle Operacional e do Plano de Qualidade de Serviço, promovendo ganhos de qualidade, produtividade e performance.
  • Fornecer suporte técnico às equipes operacionais de Completions e aos clientes, atuando como referência em processos, desempenho operacional e solução de problemas.
  • Realizar e participar de auditorias operacionais, assegurando conformidade com padrões API Q1, API Q2 e ISO 9001, além de apoiar auditorias internas e externas relacionadas à qualidade e processos.
  • Apoiar e, quando necessário, liderar investigações de falhas operacionais (eventos PC2 e PC3), conduzindo análise de causa raiz, garantindo documentação adequada e comunicação conforme fluxo estabelecido.
  • Elaborar, revisar e padronizar instruções técnicas de trabalho (Work Instructions), procedimentos operacionais e demais documentos técnicos, assegurando aderência às políticas e requisitos corporativos.
  • Atuar na gestão da qualidade e confiabilidade, por meio de análise de desempenho de processos, equipamentos e ativos, identificando tendências, desvios e riscos operacionais, e implementando ações preventivas e corretivas.
  • Apoiar a gestão e desenvolvimento de fornecedores, garantindo alinhamento com requisitos técnicos, operacionais e de qualidade.
  • Identificar e implementar oportunidades de melhoria contínua, utilizando metodologias estruturadas (Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, entre outras).
  • Garantir o cumprimento das diretrizes de QHSE, promovendo uma cultura de segurança, qualidade e integridade operacional, incluindo suporte à gestão de treinamentos conforme matrizes internas e requisitos de clientes.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Engenharia (Mecânica, Produção, Petróleo ou áreas correlatas).
  • Experiência prévia em operações de Oil & Gas.
  • Vivência de 1 a 2 anos em qualidade e processos, com atuação em tratativa de não conformidades, análise de dados e suporte à operação.
  • Conhecimento em processos operacionais, melhoria contínua e análise de desempenho.
  • Familiaridade com normas e padrões de qualidade (API Q1, API Q2, ISO 9001).
  • Experiência com investigação de falhas e análise de causa raiz (RCA, 5 Porquês, Ishikawa) e metodologias de confiabilidade (FMEA, RCM, FRACAS ou similares).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de melhoria contínua (Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, etc.) será considerado um diferencial.
  • Inglês avançado (desejável, conforme interface com times globais).
  • Habilidade analítica, com forte orientação para solução de problemas e melhoria de processos.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de atuar em equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Experiência prévia em confiabilidade e/ou formação específica na área será considerada um diferencial.
  • Vivência em auditorias internas e/ou externas.
  • Conhecimento nos softwares BlockSim e Weibull++ será considerado um diferencial.

title: Marketing Ai Agent Builder
description:
Role Overview: As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our\ "agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a\ "Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.Core Responsibilities:

- Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to\ "read\" prospect behavior andtrigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.
- Performance & Guardrails: Establish\ "human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.
- System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including HubSpot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.Qualifications & Skills:
- Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market SaaS revenue engine.
- AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.G., LangGraph, CrewAI) or low-code builder platforms (e.G., Claude CoWork, CodeX)
- Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.G., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.Com) or code-based frameworks (e.G., LangGraph, CrewAI).
- Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex\ "reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.
- Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company's internal knowledge base.
- Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Senior Business Analyst - Supply Chain
description:
Who We Are

We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.

Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.

Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain, a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.

Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Client Engagement

- Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.

- Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.

- Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

- Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

- Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.

Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

- Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).

- Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.

- Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.

- Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.

- Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.

- Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.

- Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.

- Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.

Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)

- Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.

- Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.

- Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

- Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.

Must Have

- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

- Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).

- Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.

- Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).

- Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.

- Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

- Experience with project management and collaboration tools.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.

- Availability to travel.

- Legally authorized to work in Brazil.

What We Offer

- Competitive salary and benefits package.

- Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

- A collaborative and international work environment.

- Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.

Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Professor De Inglês
description: Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo's projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo's data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter towith subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Senior Web Manager
description: About the Role: We are looking for a visionary Senior Web Manager to lead the transformation of our marketing website into a high-performing, modern digital engine. In this role, you will be the primary owner of our marketing website, sisense.Com, responsible for everything from day-to-day maintenance to leading strategic initiatives that streamline the back-end experience for our marketing team. You will be a key driver in evolving our current WordPress platform into a more efficient, scalable system. We are looking for a candidate who is not only a WordPress expert but also brings experience with modern web systems like Webflow or Contentful to help guide our long-term digital roadmap.Key Responsibilities: Strategic Web Leadership: Own the overarching strategic vision for web projects, including design, development, and optimization efforts that support annual marketing goals. Custom Development & Design: Go beyond basic management to create custom web pages and reusable components that enhance our site's flexibility and user experience. Back-End Transformation: Lead the evolution of our website's back-end to create a more streamlined, user-friendly experience for internal marketing content creators. Platform Management: Oversee the functionality and performance of our current WordPress platform while evaluating and potentially integrating new tools like Webflow or Contentful. Performance & Optimization: Monitor and report on key metrics (traffic, conversion rates, SEO, page speed) and execute A/B tests to drive continuous improvement. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Demand Gen, Product Marketing, Brand, and IT teams to ensure the website accurately represents our brand and delivers qualified leads. Vendor & Technical Management: Manage relationships with external agencies and developers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.What We're Looking For: Experience: 5–8+ years in web management or digital strategy, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment. Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in WordPress (current platform of record) is required. Strong preference for candidates with hands-on experience in Webflow or Contentful. Frontend Skills: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build and troubleshoot custom web components. SEO & Analytics: Advanced knowledge of technical SEO principles and web analytics tools like GA4 and Google Tag Manager. Project Management: Proven ability to manage complex website redesigns or migrations from strategy through execution. Mindset: A data-driven, self-starter who can translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and is passionate about building a best-in-class digital experience.Why Join Us: This is a high-impact role where you will have the autonomy to shape our digital future. You'll be part of a team that values innovation, out-of-the-box thinking, and creating exceptional customer experiences.

title: Senior Compliance Manager
description:
About BingX

  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users

Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.

BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.

Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE

The Senior Compliance Manager will join the global legal and compliance team, with a primary focus on Brazil and the broader Latin American regulatory landscape. This role requires a proactive self-starter with a strong interest in financial innovation and digital assets, who thrives in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will lead regulatory and licensing efforts related to crypto operations in Brazil while supporting regional expansion initiatives.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead regulatory compliance strategy and licensing/registration efforts for crypto-related activities in Brazil, including engagement with the Central Bank of Brazil (BCB), Comissão de Valores Mobiliários (CVM), and other relevant authorities
  • Monitor and interpret developments in Brazil's crypto regulatory framework (e.G., Law No. 14,478/2022 and related regulations), and assess their impact on business operations
  • Act as the primary project manager for licensing and regulatory initiatives, coordinating with external counsel, consultants, and internal stakeholders
  • Provide clear, practical, and solution-oriented compliance guidance to product, operations, and business teams to enable compliant product launches and expansion
  • Deliver internal training programs and update training materials to reflect regulatory changes and best practices
  • Represent the company in interactions with regulators, financial institutions, partners, and industry groups in Brazil

Knowledge:

  • Strong understanding of Brazil's crypto and financial regulatory environment, including digital asset frameworks and payment systems (e.G., PIX)
  • Familiarity with AML/CFT regulations, data protection (LGPD), and financial consumer protection laws in Brazil
  • Experience in the crypto, fintech, or payments industry is highly preferred
  • Understanding of global regulatory trends in digital assets is a plus

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Law, Finance, Business, or a related field
  • 7 to 9 years of regulatory compliance experience, with at least 3 years focused on crypto, fintech, payments, or financial services in Brazil
  • Proven experience handling regulatory licensing, compliance frameworks, and regulator engagement in Brazil
  • Ability to advise on regulatory implications for product design, modification, and market expansion
  • Strong ability to navigate a dynamic and evolving regulatory landscape with ambiguity
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills and ability to work cross-functionally with senior management
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to remain composed under pressure
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Portuguese (Mandarin is a plus but not required)
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively and deliver practical, scalable compliance solutions
  • Proficiency in MS Office applications

Working at BingX

  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefit

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role:

We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.

Key responsibilities:

- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.

Requirements:

- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.

Benefits:

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Clinical Study Manager
description: Job Summary The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia's headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials. Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required. Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects. Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines. Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies. Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation. In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.G., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required. Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials. Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable. Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions. Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable. Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product. Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead. Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans. Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.E. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation. Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report. Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites. Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives. Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed. Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.Education and Experience Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management. Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.G. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.). Experience managing clinical project team personnel. Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies. Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations. Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports. Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process. Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US. Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members. Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a 'can-do' attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects. Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus. Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment. Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers. Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate. Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment. Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment. Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).. Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers. Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business. Must be fluent in English
